_about: Real-world results per agent, by the metric that decides whether the agent's work succeeded in the world, not only whether it ran well. Values are AGGREGATES only (counts, rates, medians): no names, contacts or content. Every value is recorded with its source (`agent-metrics.mjs result`) so the auditor can check where it came from. Under min_n the auditor says 'too little data', never pass or fail. Written by Claude from Yotam's rule (Nov 2026); Yotam confirms the thresholds.

content-planner.judged_by: Instagram/Facebook account data (insights via n8n), per post, against the account's own previous median
content-planner.source_hint: Meta insights via n8n, or a manual export of insights after publishing

analyst.judged_by: whether the experiments it proposed were run and produced a measured, decided result

customer-finder.judged_by: whether the prospects it found became regular paying customers
customer-finder.source_hint: D2R lead/customer records (aggregated by Yotam or an ingest read-back)

metrics.note: recurring = still paying after at least two consecutive billing periods

lead-followup.judged_by: speed of answering and whether leads became paying

quote-pricing.judged_by: whether quotes were accepted and at what price versus the proposal
quote-pricing.source_hint: Yotam's records of quotes sent and answers

demand-scanner.judged_by: quality and conversion of verified opportunities, not volume of data collected (spec 8.8)
demand-scanner.source_hint: opportunity-audit.mjs stats, sources.json, outreach.json, Yotam's own records

metrics.note: opportunities not yet published as projects

product-intake.judged_by: whether verified product files led to content that was approved
product-intake.source_hint: outcomes.jsonl for content-planner items of that product

intake.judged_by: operational only: did the daily watch catch what mattered
intake.source_hint: Yotam's verdicts on missed or false alerts

auditor.judged_by: whether its verdicts agree with Yotam's own verdicts on the same items
